name: dsh-deckcraft
description: Slides from the chat: four `deck_*` tools over the user's own DeckCraft CLI (storytold/deckcraft, MIT OR Apache-2.0) - `deck_status` (the CLI, its version, and whether a running DeckCraft answers the control channel), `deck_commands` (the command ids this build offers, so nothing is hardcoded), `deck_run` (one command or a batch, saved as a `.deckcraft` file in the workspace) and `deck_export` (render slides to PNG into the workspace). Host-only, argv-only, outputs scoped to the session workspace. Zero npm dependencies, no engine bundled, no network egress of its own.
